test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

You have adopted the plan.

options.text: The plan should be adopted by you.
The plan is adopted by you.
The plan has being adopted by you.
The plan has been adopted by you.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The plan has been adopted by you.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is written in the **present perfect tense**.

 
 
• **Active Voice Structure** (Present Perfect Tense): Subject + have/has + past participle (V3) + Object__
 
• **Passive Voice Structure** (Present Perfect Tense): __Object + has/have been + past participle (V3) + by + Subject__
 
 
 
• The sentence is in active voice, with the subject '**you**' performing the action of adopting the plan.
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to make the object of the sentence ('**the plan**') the subject, and use a form of 'be' + past participle of the verb ('**been adopted**') to show that the action has been done to the subject.
 
• The preposition '**by**' is used to show who performed the action (in this case, 'you').
 
• The sentence in passive voice becomes '*The plan has been adopted by you*.'

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
